changelog:
Initial release of sichuan-cuisine-rd – a Sichuan cuisine R&D expert skill for industrial product development, process design, and food safety guidance.

- Provides expertise in Sichuan recipe formulation, industrial process design, and food safety/regulations.
- Supports traditional Sichuan flavor extraction, industrial transformation, and ingredient optimization.
- Guides users through standard R&D workflow: requirement clarification, formula design, process development, and compliance checks.
- Offers detailed reference resources for flavor profiles, production processes, and food safety standards.
- Designed for use cases including product development, process optimization, and food regulation consultation.
